content: Karan Joshi emailed Aditi Mahajan regarding the upcoming expiration of her Health Plus policy on 05/10/2026, offering options to either renew the current plan or upgrade to the Health Plus Plus plan. Aditi responded expressing interest in the upgrade, requesting a detailed quote for coverage limits and premium changes, along with instructions on how to switch before expiration.

action_items: Provide a detailed quote for the Health Plus Plus upgrade
Outline the steps required to switch to the upgraded plan
